palette: C_SYS (AR40's C, the system panel), research's pick B

levels.note: each over B's panel, top and foot; every level wears the dark outline of AR44's plain take

Skull.tint: the tier's colour (ImageColor3); its rim stays dark under any tint
Skull.use: the difficulty skull: drawn 16 points high in an 18 point box, its centre the anchor. On a Shade's and an elite's card at 15 high (the box 16.9), a keeper's at 17 (19.1); its centre 14 from the card's left, on the level's row. The faint tier at ImageTransparency 0.45; the others solid

EdgeArrow.use: the type edge, right of the type gem, 9 points high: up as drawn; down at Rotation 180

CardRankEdge.use: an elite's and a keeper's edge, in place of PanelEdge: brass, the kit panel's own cut, sliced like it (Cut 12 each side). Its own colours, never tinted

RankHornLeft.use: a horn's root (the anchor) on the card's top edge, 14 in from its left corner. A keeper's at 14 high, as drawn; an elite's at 11 (scale 11/14, its anchor with it). Over the card, under nothing

RankHornRight.use: the left horn mirrored: its root 14 in from the card's right corner

RankCrest.use: a keeper's crest: three brass shards, the anchor on the card's top edge at its middle

PhaseNotch.use: a keeper's phase: the anchor on the bar's top edge, at 1/3 and 2/3 of its length. Drawn for the keeper's 15 point bar with its slant (0.45 of its height); the dark cut through the light, the brass point above

CrTab.use: CR's gold tab, drawn for a 24 point number: its plate's left, top, width and height in the box. It scales with the number (a 14 point number takes 14/24). "CR" is the game's text over it: dark ink #4A2A08, bold, 0.62 of the number's size, centred on the plate; the number right of it in ivory #F7F1E3, upright and wide apart, with AR44's plain take's outline and shadow
